decisions.statement: No message is taken back once that message is sent.
A recipient that looks like a number or an address is used rather than looked up.
A name landing on nobody or on more than one person is refused.
A person's first phone number is preferred over their first address.
Saying neither a body nor a picture is refused.
A picture past ten megabytes is refused before anything is sent.
A picture is read off the disk before the recipient is looked up.
A body read from a file has no closing line ending.
A picture a call names is hung off the message.
A send that landed is named as soon as the script on the mac says so.
A picture that failed after the text names that text in its refusal.
The lines the mac answers are handed in.

definition: the command handing one message to the Messages app on the mac
